description: This Mac as a work host (ADR-0188 D2 · R1, #2778): the seven work_host_* commands that start, stop, register and forget the bundled momo-workd sidecar and choose this Mac's 「원격 작업」 account (set it / prepare its folder, #3157; the webview names a harness and a label, never a path). For the main window's own webview (label `main`) on the bundled (local) origin only, macOS only (the sidecar and its code-signature check exist there only). Scoped by webview like pty.json so a child webview does not inherit it. No `remote` entry: a page from the network must never register this Mac as a host.
